shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|spec:\" src --glob '*test.ts' | head -80 && cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log --oneline -8 && ls src/orchestration/*beforeSession* 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts && rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+|@spec|SPEC\" src --glob '*test.ts' | head -100 && sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"\\[specs/|specs/.*#[0-9]+\" . --glob '*test*' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!dist/**'"' | head -100; sed -n '1,240p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; rg -n \"validated by\" specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"spec anchor|specs/.+#[0-9]+|validated by name|VALIDATED_BY|spec:\" scripts .lore specs adrs src --glob '"'!*.map'"' | head -200"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git commit -m "fix: run cleanup when beforeSession throws" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
